name: University of El Segundo
identity: An independent, art-forward learning project rooted in El Segundo. Not an accredited institution or a City of El Segundo program.
schoolNote: Schools are browsing groups for independent inquiry; they do not imply staffed academic departments or degree programs.
publicationPolicy: Live means the public page identity was checked on the stated date. Proposed entries have no public link. A verification date is not a publication date. Per-study checkedAt and sourceURL/sourceCommit identify individual verification cohorts. Directory-level checkedAt and verificationSourceRevision retain the older source cohort and do not redate every linked resource.

schools.name: Place + planet
schools.description: Observe a living radius: weather, land, nature and shared space.

schools.name: Business + decisions
schools.description: Compare business models, markets, evidence and uncertain futures.

schools.name: Life + care
schools.description: Practice attention, memory, repair and care for one another.

schools.name: Tools + making
schools.description: Make useful artifacts with art, software and editorial judgment.

studies.title: Coffee, from counter to case study
studies.description: Explore a bounded 25-mile café and roaster sample, dated menus and whole beans, then compare café, wholesale and subscription economics. Inventory observations are partial; calculator inputs are illustrative.
limits: Selected sample, not a census; no live stock or actual shop revenue claims.

studies.title: Prediction markets
studies.description: Twelve lessons and six synthetic labs connect probability, trading mechanics, incentives and uncertainty. Conditional 2027 scenarios are teaching tools.
limits: No account opening, orders, wallet connection or live trading strategy.

studies.title: Groundwork: real estate observatory
studies.description: Study a 25-mile local radius and global real estate foundations; edit assumptions in a hypothetical five-year acquisition lab.
limits: Representative qualitative research; no active property inventory or observed-yield assertion.

studies.title: A field guide to plugins
studies.description: A published educational draft on skills, MCP, plugins, discovery, events and hosting. It explains tools and availability boundaries; it does not install or activate a plugin.
limits: Native publicationStatus remains draft-review-required; featureActivation is false. This is a public guide, not an installed plugin.

studies.title: The business casebook
studies.description: Start with café and retail case-study methods: source quality, inventory limits, business models and clearly labelled assumptions.
limits: The registry still marks real estate and business signals pending; public verification can support a deliberate later synchronization.

studies.title: RADIUS / 90245
studies.description: Move a hypothetical receiver through the local field layer and compare modeled radio propagation, link budgets and signal margins.
limits: Free-space model and schematic geography; not a measured RF coverage map.

studies.title: The Rebuildable Town
studies.description: Revisit the historical six-lesson field study in inhabitable software. Its original address remains available alongside the current course catalog.
limits: Current catalogue lists UES-05 under previousCurriculum; its legacy JSON still says enrollment open.

studies.title: The state of electricity
studies.description: Follow electricity from early circuits to today’s grid, then explore California and El Segundo pathways, power and energy lessons, and illustrative solar and storage economics.
limits: Published educational study. Calculator assumptions are illustrative, not utility quotes, engineering design or guaranteed savings.

studies.title: Read a place. Make a question.
studies.description: Sixteen independent activities turn four source-based regional stories about Japan, China, Brazil and the United States into maps, evidence cards and comparisons.
limits: Published independent reading and learning activities; this does not establish staffed course availability, enrollment, accreditation or an application route.

studies.title: Beam: a promise to test.
studies.description: An announcement and documentation review of Reflection’s Beam, its deployment questions, and a useful way to evaluate a new model before adopting it. No hands-on model testing or independent benchmark reproduction is claimed.
limits: Published announcement and documentation review. Weights and licensing remain promised, benchmarks are vendor-reported, and no hands-on model testing or independent reproduction is claimed.

studies.title: Human energy
studies.description: Proposed study of attention, vitality and recovery, with clear distinctions between cultural traditions and scientific evidence. A public curriculum has not yet been verified.

studies.title: Plant & nature interaction
studies.description: Proposed study of plants, ecology, people and place through observation and small acts of care. Its requested public curriculum is pending verification.

studies.title: Grief & explorations
studies.description: Proposed educational companion for remembering loss, finding gentle support and being alongside someone else. A public release has not yet been verified.

studies.title: Weather-sharing
studies.description: Proposed study of observing weather together and sharing useful local records. The requested study has no verified public release yet.

studies.title: Public spaces
studies.description: Proposed field study of access, stewardship and the everyday use of shared places. Publication is pending verification.

studies.title: IndustryNext business companion
studies.description: A companion for comparing business models and working through illustrative assumptions. Its separate publication is pending verification.

studies.title: Nature Practice
studies.description: An existing twelve-month pathway through species, observation and architectural questions. This is a related published resource, separate from the proposed plant-and-nature study.
limits: Distinct from the newly requested unpublished studies.

studies.title: Weather & Living Atlas
studies.description: Explore historical climate and seasonal living in an existing atlas. This is a related published resource, separate from the proposed weather-sharing study; it is not a forecast.
limits: Distinct from the newly requested unpublished studies.

studies.title: Beach Commons
studies.description: Explore the existing visual field series of shared-place concepts. This related published resource is separate from the proposed public-spaces study.
limits: Distinct from the newly requested unpublished studies.
